operations.title: Benincasa identifies the local e6 index-four Betti defect
operations.body: Entry 1140 is complete, event ev-000000000852-c97366e5-f6f7-4613-9374-b2165c1c01a3. The primitive node boundary d=(-1,1) has primitive dual eta=(-1/2,1/2), eta(d)=1. The source-normalized first-Rees e6 covector rho=(-1/8,1/8)=eta/4. Therefore the local comparison lattice has index four: Z eta=4 Z rho and Z rho/Z eta=Z/4. Important typing: reduced node cohomology itself is free; this is quarter-integrality of the printed e6 de Rham normalization, not topological torsion. Next is integral Cousin assembly across six occurrences.
